intake_statement: For the critical random-cluster model with cluster weight q <= 4 on Dobrushin domains, the exploration path converges to SLE(kappa) with kappa = 4 pi / (pi - arccos(sqrt q / 2)).
primary_2017_quote: Fix q <= 4 and p = pc. Let (Omega_delta, a_delta, b_delta) be Dobrushin domains approximating a simply connected domain Omega with two marked points a and b on its boundary. The exploration path ... converges weakly to SLE(kappa) as delta tends to 0
recent_claim_scope: The October 5 2026 manuscript claims the square lattice for fixed 1 <= q <= 4 under uniform marked Jordan boundary approximation; its September 23 companion claims 0 < q < 1 for smooth Jordan boundary approximation.
